title.narrative: Adecuacin Servicios Sanidad Agropecuaria y Forestal
Improvement of Plant, Animal and Forest Health Services

description.narrative: Strengthening of the animal and plant health services in 4 areas that are fundamental to achieve competitiveness and access to the international markets: (i) plant and animal health: prevention, erradication and control of plagues and livestock diseases; (ii) food safety: modernization of the legal framework, establishment of a national agrifood certificacion system; identification and establishment of good practices.
